name: clauster-e2e-tooling
description: Dev-only Node tooling for the Clauster E2E suite. Not published — pins the agent-browser CLI with an integrity-checked lockfile (npm ci) instead of an unpinned `npm i -g` global install (OpenSSF Scorecard Pinned-Dependencies). Held at 0.27.1: 0.27.3 regressed the trust-gate `check`, and 0.34.0 / 0.35.1 were empirically WORSE under CPU contention on the shared 4-vCPU CI runner and on an identical local harness — the first command after `close --all` fails with `Could not configure browser: Failed to connect: No such file or directory` (the CLI races its own daemon startup) and clicks stop registering. The driver's self-verifying fill + visibility-gated click and the e2e leg's --reruns (scripts/e2e.sh) absorb what remains. Bump deliberately + re-verify on CI, not just locally.
